chain.why: The median private‑hospital stay costs about ₹24,000, which can exceed the amount many people pay in annual premiums.
About three hospital admissions occur per 100 urban residents each year, indicating that hospitalisation is not rare.
Around one in nine Indian adults has diabetes and more than one in three has high blood pressure, showing that health problems can develop even in people who feel healthy now.
The average health claim paid in 2024–25 was about ₹28,900, close to the cost of a typical hospital stay, demonstrating the financial impact of a claim.

conclusion: Thus, relying on savings alone is risky because hospital stays can cost as much as the premium, admissions are common, chronic conditions affect many adults, and typical claims are around ₹28,900.
